description: nanobot-ai releases auto-merge immediately; everything else is batched into one monthly auto-merged PR; majors of other dependencies wait for approval. Every merge is gated by the A1-A22 acceptance suite (required check). See README 'Published image and updates'.

customManagers.description: Dockerfile ARG pins annotated with '# renovate:' comments; an optional *_COMMIT line right after the *_VERSION line is updated as its digest.

packageRules.description: Base images stay on their tag line (python 3.12, bookworm); only digests are updated. Changing the line is a deliberate edit.
Everything except nanobot-ai: one grouped PR on the 1st of the month, auto-merged when the suite passes.
Majors of everything except nanobot-ai: separate PRs that wait for manual approval.
nanobot-ai: every stable release (majors included) as soon as it is 2 days old, auto-merged when the suite passes.
